Topic: Antibiotic Resistance Prediction Using Patient Data
Dataset Name: DRIAMS – Resistance to Antibiotics (MALDI-TOF Mass Spectra)
Columns: MALDI-TOF spectrum bins, species, antibiotic, resistance_label (S/R/I)
Description: A large-scale database pairing MALDI-TOF mass spectra of bacterial isolates with antibiotic susceptibility test results, enabling ML models to predict resistance directly from mass-spectrometry patient data across multiple pathogens and antibiotics.

Topic: Antibiotic Resistance Prediction Using Patient Data
Dataset Name: BacBench Antibiotic Resistance DNA (Genomic Sequences)
Columns: genome_id, genome_dna_sequence, antibiotic, mic_value, binary_label (resistant/susceptible)
Description: Whole bacterial genome DNA sequences extracted from GenBank, annotated with binary resistance/susceptibility labels and MIC regression values for 56 unique antimicrobials sourced from the AST Browser, intended as a multi-scale genomics benchmark.

Topic: Antibiotic Resistance Prediction Using Patient Data
Dataset Name: Antimicrobial Resistance Data – European Surveillance
Columns: country, year, microbe, antibiotic, resistance_rate, susceptibility_rate, n_isolates
Description: Surveillance data covering resistance rates of 7 major microbes across 28 European countries over 3 years, useful for training models that predict regional resistance trends from epidemiological and clinical covariates.

Topic: Antibiotic Resistance Prediction Using Patient Data
Dataset Name: Antibiotic Resistance in Gonorrhoea – DNA Unitigs
Columns: unitig_sequence, isolate_id, azithromycin_resistance, ceftriaxone_resistance, ciprofloxacin_resistance
Description: Segments of Neisseria gonorrhoeae bacterial DNA (unitigs) paired with antibiotic resistance labels across multiple drug classes, enabling ML models to predict resistance phenotype from genomic sequence data.

Topic: Antibiotic Resistance Prediction Using Patient Data
Dataset Name: ATLAS – Antimicrobial Testing Leadership and Surveillance Database
Columns: patient_id, country, year, pathogen, antibiotic, MIC_value, susceptibility_category, infection_source, age_group, sex
Description: An open-access clinical MIC database comprising 6.5 million susceptibility measurements for over 3,900 pathogen-antibiotic pairs from 633,000 patients across 70 countries (2004–2017), making it the only large-scale open AMR dataset that includes patient metadata.

Topic: Drug-Drug Interaction Detection Using ML
Dataset Name: Drug-Drug Interactions Dataset
Columns: drug1_name, drug2_name, interaction_type, severity, mechanism, description
Description: A curated collection of pairwise drug-drug interactions with interaction type labels, severity ratings, and mechanism descriptions, well-suited for building multi-class DDI classification models.

Topic: Drug-Drug Interaction Detection Using ML
Dataset Name: DDinter – Drug-Drug Interactions Database
Columns: drug_A, drug_B, level (minor/moderate/major/contraindicated), atc_code_A, atc_code_B, mechanism, clinical_consequence
Description: The DDinter database of clinically reviewed pairwise drug interactions labelled by severity level (minor to contraindicated), enabling ML models to learn interaction classification from drug identity and ATC class features.

Topic: Drug-Drug Interaction Detection Using ML
Dataset Name: ADE Corpus V2 – Adverse Drug Event & Relation Extraction
Columns: text (sentence), label (ADE-related: True/False), drug, adverse_effect, drug_dose
Description: A double-annotated benchmark corpus of medical case reports used for classifying sentences as ADE-related and for extracting drug-adverse effect and drug-dose relations, widely used as a standard NLP benchmark for pharmacovigilance.

Topic: Drug-Drug Interaction Detection Using ML
Dataset Name: DrugBank Multi-Typed DDI (via DD100 Benchmark)
Columns: drug1_smiles, drug2_smiles, drug1_name, drug2_name, interaction_type, label
Description: A multi-task drug discovery benchmark covering 100+ tasks including DrugBank multi-typed DDI, TWOSIDES polypharmacy side effects, and CYP450 interactions, designed for evaluating LLMs and ML models on pharmacological reasoning.

Topic: Drug-Drug Interaction Detection Using ML
Dataset Name: TWOSIDES – Polypharmacy Drug-Drug Side Effects
Columns: drug1_rxcui, drug2_rxcui, drug1_name, drug2_name, side_effect_cui, side_effect_name, proportional_reporting_ratio
Description: A canonical polypharmacy side-effect dataset extracted from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System, documenting statistically significant drug-drug side effects for 645 drugs and over 63,000 interacting pairs, widely used as a DDI ML benchmark.

Topic: Chemotherapy Response Prediction
Dataset Name: TCGA Chemotherapy Response Dataset
Columns: patient_id, cancer_type, drug_name, clinical_response (CR/PR/SD/PD), gene_expression_features, tumor_immunome_features, staging
Description: Chemotherapy response data for TCGA cancer patients cross-referenced with the TCIA immunome database, covering 5 common agents (FOLFOX, 5FU, Oxaliplatin, Carboplatin, Cisplatin) for colorectal and lung cancer, integrating clinical, genomic, and immunological features.

Topic: Chemotherapy Response Prediction
Dataset Name: Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC)
Columns: cell_line_name, cancer_type, drug_name, IC50, AUC, gene_expression, copy_number_variation, somatic_mutation, drug_SMILES
Description: Large-scale pharmacogenomic profiling of 1,000+ cancer cell lines tested against hundreds of anti-cancer drugs, providing IC50 and AUC drug sensitivity values alongside genomic features, making it the most widely used benchmark for drug response prediction models.

Topic: Chemotherapy Response Prediction
Dataset Name: Cancer Cell Line Encyclopedia (CCLE)
Columns: cell_line_name, tissue_type, drug_name, EC50, ActArea, gene_expression, mutation_data, copy_number_data
Description: Broad Institute pharmacogenomic profiling of ~1,000 cancer cell lines measuring drug activity (EC50, ActArea) for 24 anti-cancer compounds alongside comprehensive genomic characterization, used widely for chemotherapy sensitivity and resistance modelling.

Topic: Chemotherapy Response Prediction
Dataset Name: Breast Cancer Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Response (GEO Curated)
Columns: patient_id, age, tumor_size, grade, hormone_receptor_status, HER2_status, treatment_regimen, pCR_response (0/1), gene_expression_features
Description: Patient-level breast cancer dataset containing clinical variables, biomarkers, and neoadjuvant chemotherapy regimen details labelled with pathological complete response (pCR), suitable for binary treatment-response classification models.

Topic: Chemotherapy Response Prediction
Dataset Name: NCI-60 Human Tumor Cell Line Drug Sensitivity
Columns: cell_line_name, cancer_type, drug_name, GI50, LC50, TGI, gene_expression, protein_expression, microRNA
Description: The NCI's pioneering panel of 60 genomically characterized human tumor cell lines screened against over 21,000 compounds, providing GI50/LC50 growth inhibition data alongside multi-omics profiles, used as the historical benchmark for cancer drug response prediction.

Topic: Adverse Drug Reaction Classification from Clinical Records
Dataset Name: ADE Corpus V2 – Drug Adverse Effect Classification
Columns: sentence, ade_label (True/False), drug_entity, adverse_effect_entity, drug_dose
Description: A systematically double-annotated corpus of medical case reports for classifying sentences as ADE-related and extracting drug-adverse effect/dose relations; widely regarded as the standard NLP benchmark for adverse drug reaction detection from clinical text.

Topic: Adverse Drug Reaction Classification from Clinical Records
Dataset Name: PsyTAR – Psychiatric Treatment Adverse Reactions
Columns: review_id, drug_name, sentence, label (ADR/WD/SSI/DI/EF/INF/Other), named_entity, patient_demographics, treatment_duration, satisfaction_score
Description: Patient-generated narratives from an online health forum about four psychiatric medications (Zoloft, Lexapro, Cymbalta, Effexor XR), annotated for adverse reactions, withdrawal symptoms, drug effectiveness, and drug indications across 6,009 sentences.

Topic: Adverse Drug Reaction Classification from Clinical Records
Dataset Name: FDA Adverse Pharmaceutical Events (FAERS)
Columns: primaryid, drug_name, reaction_meddra, outcome, serious, reporter_country, age, sex, weight, indication, route_of_administration
Description: FDA's official Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) data published on Kaggle, containing millions of post-market adverse event reports with drug names, MedDRA-coded reactions, patient demographics, and outcome severity indicators.

Topic: Adverse Drug Reaction Classification from Clinical Records
Dataset Name: SPL-ADR-200db – FDA Drug Labels Annotated for ADRs
Columns: drug_name, spl_section, mention_text, adr_term, umls_cui, meddra_code, normalized_adr
Description: FDA-NLM collaborative pilot dataset of 200 FDA-approved drug Structured Product Labels manually annotated for adverse drug reactions at the mention level, then normalized to UMLS and MedDRA, containing 5,098 distinct ADRs for NLP model training.

Topic: Adverse Drug Reaction Classification from Clinical Records
Dataset Name: n2c2 2018 Track 2 – ADE Extraction from Clinical Narratives
Columns: doc_id, text (clinical note), medication_entity, ade_entity, severity, relation_type, dosage, route, frequency
Description: Clinical discharge summaries annotated for medication information and adverse drug events (ADE) extraction as part of the 2018 n2c2 NLP shared task, supporting concept extraction, relation classification, and end-to-end ADE detection from raw clinical text.
